contracts: documentSuggestionsV1 is separately negotiated against an already enabled writer-transport V2 room. Unnegotiated clients receive neither suggestion descriptor/permission fields nor suggestion hints. No remote lane-activation request is added.

The compatible optional stack admits eight requested capabilities; mutually exclusive presence modes and original review capability dependencies retain their original checks. Unsupported optional assets remain unadvertised.

Every suggestion transport action has its own named documented Rust file. Publication/read/page/packet operations bind the exact durable lane. Grant is owner-only; authenticated target account selectors are never actor authority.

Accept derives the exact current document-author lease from connection state. Payload principal/writer/lease/effect/frame claims are refused by closed envelopes. Reject may use a Reader reviewer without a document-author lease.

All requests recheck current native authority inside the serialized room transaction. Handshake and changed-hint permission displays are not credentials. Native uncertain-storage fencing remains unchanged.

A suggestion-only reader can register/resume a permanently non-authoring document identity without negotiating comments. Promotion invalidates old leases and requires resume, but never converts that identity into an author. Existing review observer response meanings are retained.

New durable decisions emit coalesced suggestion hints and ordinary document catchup only after the single decision/effect fsync. Receipt and frame delivery order is not a license to re-execute commands or infer history ownership.

Opposing and queued retries return the original durable winner, receipt, principal and exact accepting device, without another append or document effect. A client-owned offline choice is not server-finalized until reconnect.

Native source conflicts remain pending; Reject does not delete accepted content. Ordinary offline document edits continue through their own streams and retain selective native Undo/Redo independently from imported host effects.
The original bounded socket envelope, native packet/page budgets, connection limits and backpressure remain in force. No existing persisted journal or transport frame changes meaning.
verificationNotes: The initial probe wrongly expected a heading-only proposal to conflict after text changed. Native dependencies correctly preserve independent heading/text fields; the conflict fixture was corrected to a text intent. Production semantics were not changed to satisfy that assertion.

An initial restart assertion compared a Reader's live permission display with an Editor's. Immutable events/cursors matched; the corrected assertion verifies identical retained events with each account's fresh current permissions.

The promotion probe initially reused an invalidated observer lease and hit the existing deliberate connection fence. Request-name-only diagnostics identified the exact failed read. The final test reconnects/resumes the same permanent observer, then proves Accept is still refused under fresh Editor rights. No lease-fencing behavior was weakened.
One diagnostic edit attempt timed out in automatic permission review before applying; a scoped retry succeeded. This was not treated as a security rejection.
Formatting is scoped to changed Rust files. Unrelated pre-existing document_presence.rs formatting remains unchanged.
